dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: Hello, Honorary Senior Researcher. I'm so happy to see you...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I used to be a clerk in 5th Finances Office at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I was at the Maison Gestion discussing the delivery of some reports when the institute blew up. So I was lucky enough to, you know... not get blown up...

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: But our office and all our financial reports were blown to smithereens.

dialogues.speaker: Lanty
dialogues.text: I mean, it's not bad news. But it's not good news, either...
